BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to an intercollegiate and community swim facility;creating a new section; and making an appropriation.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that the developmentof a combined intercollegiate and community swim facility at theUniversity of Washington will provide a significant benefit to thestate. It is therefore the intent of the legislature to support a swimfacility with the capacity to accommodate intercollegiate swim and divecompetitions, including spring board and platform diving. The facilityshall also support university intramural and recreational activities bystudents, faculty, and staff. Community use shall also be accommodatedand scheduled for local competitive swim teams, swim lessons, swimcamps, and high school competitions.

The sum of ten million dollars, or as muchthereof as may be necessary, is appropriated for the biennium endingJune 30, 2005, from the state building construction account to theUniversity of Washington as matching funds for the construction of a p. 1 SB 5008collegiate and community swim facility. The amount provided in thisact shall be matched by an equal amount from combined donations ofinstitutional, student, and private donations.
